title: Resources
text: A collection of things I’ve found useful, interesting, or good. A mixture of tools, books, datasets, tutorials, and rabbit holes.

title: Resources
text:
Recommended
Two awesome curated lists of lists of free software and data:

⭐ Free Lunch
⭐ Awesome Public Datasets

title: Resources
text:
Things to use

Tools and utilities

⭐ ColorSpace - Create colour palettes online.
⭐ Cycle.Travel - A bicycle route planner built around quieter roads.
⭐ Windy - Beautiful weather maps.
The Bike Market - A great tool for checking pricing on used motorcycles across the UK market.
Ninety 180 - Visualise post-Brexit EU stay days.
DiskPrices - Compare the cost of digital storage.
Radio Garden - Live radio stations from around the world.
Upscayl - Open source AI image upscaler. 



Things to play with

⭐ Lakera Agent Breaker - Teaches you to hack AI.
⭐ Data Viz Project - A catalogue of visualisation types, useful when you know what you want to say but not what shape it should take.
⭐ Learn Git Branching - Learn Git branching. 
SQL Murder Mystery - Learn SQL by solving a murder. 
Google Dataset Search - Search for datasets across the web.
ExplainShell - Paste in ugly SQL, get a breakdown of what every flag does. 
W3Schools SQL Tutorial - Beginner SQL guide.
SQLFormat - Paste in ugly SQL, get tidy SQL back.
Mockaroo - Generate realistic synthetic data.
TableConvert - Convert tables between formats. CSV to Markdown, JSON to SQL, and most combinations you’d need.
Excel Practice Online - Free Excel exercises.



Self-hosted

⭐ Immich - Google Photos alternative. 
Project Nomad - An offline knowledge server. 
Actual Budget - Personal finance software. 
Documenso - Docusign alternative. 
Meetily - Granola alternative. 
FluidVoice - Dictation. 
OpenCut - Capcut alternative. 
openGym - Workout tracking.

title: Resources
text:
Things to learn from

Introductory guides to R and data science

⭐ R for Data Science - Hands-on guide to data science with R. 
⭐ Introduction to Statistical Learning - Foundational machine learning textbook.
⭐ Fundamentals of Data Visualisation - Comprehensive visualisation concepts. 
Just Enough R - Concise intro to R for beginners.
Virgilio - “Your new Mentor for Data Science E-Learning.”
YaRrr! The Pirate’s Guide to R - Accessible R programming guide.
The Big Book of R - “Your last-ever R-related bookmark.”
Statistical Rethinking - Key applied statistics textbook. 
Statistical Rethinking Recoded - Recoded exercises from the book.
Python for Data Analysis - Python textbook. 



Advanced R and statistical modelling

⭐ Beyond Multiple Linear Regression - For when ordinary regression stops being enough. 
⭐ Applied Regression and Multilevel Models - Guide to regression and multilevel models.
Advanced R - Deep dive into R programming. 
Models by Example - Practical statistical modeling examples. 
Multilevel Model Overview - Introductory video on multilevel models.
Introduction to Multilevel Models - Tutorial for multilevel models in R.
Multilevel Model Specification - Detailed model specification.
Multilevel Model Bootcamp - Comprehensive workshop material.
Nested Data Analysis - Video on nested data analysis.
Multilevel Models and Clustering - Guide on clustering methods.
Hierarchical Clustering on Categorical Data in R - Introduction to hierarchical clustering.
Hierarchical Models in R - In-depth look at hierarchical models.
AllFit - Tool for evaluating multilevel models.
Longitudinal Data Analysis - Methods for data that changes over time.
Statistical Modeling, Causal Inference, and Social Science - Blog by Andrew Gelman.



Geographic data science

⭐ Geographic Data Science - Intro to geographic data science in Python.
Geocomputation with R - Advanced geospatial data analysis. 
Geographic Data Science Course - Additional course on geographic data science.
Mapping and Modelling Geographic Data in R - Mixed-methods spatial modeling.
Spatial Causal Inference - Spatial analysis and causal inference.
Spatial Statistics for Data Science - Spatial statistics with R.
Spatial Microsimulation - Techniques in spatial microsimulation. 
Urban Analytics and City Science - Guide to urban data analysis.
Data Science for Transport Planning - Open source resource list for course at Leeds University.
Free GIS Data - A huge, well-maintained collection of free GIS datasets and data sources.
Esri GIS Blog - Tutorials and GIS resources.
QGIS User Group - Flickr community for QGIS projects.
HelenMakesMaps - Tutorials and GIS advocacy.

title: Tom Cantellow
text:
Tom Cantellow

Data Scientist & Policy Analyst
PhD, Quantitative Human Geography
Politics | Economics | Geography




I use data science to study the economy, society, and politics of Britain. I’m currently working at Defra applying these methods to policy challenges.
I’m available to consult and collaborate on map production, data analysis, and more. Get in touch.

title: Projects
text:
Net Zero Vulnerability Index




I developed an index to compare the vulnerability of UK regions to green economic restructuring.

Website · Article







A spatial typology of energy (in)efficiency




Published in Environment and Planning B: Urban Analytics and City Science, this journal article explores energy and housing characteristics for private rentals in the UK.

Article







The Salt Fringe




Published in Geo: Geography and Environment, this journal article explores the energy efficiency of homes in seaside towns.

Article







Neoliberalism’s New Divides




My PhD thesis explores contemporary inequality and politics in the UK, with a focus on cultural and economic cleavages.

Thesis







Retrofitting Rentals




A project assessing the state of energy efficiency in Bristol’s private rental sector.

Report · Map







Good Credit Index




I produced all maps included in Demos’ 2023 Good Credit Index Report.

Report







Cryptoassets Briefing




A briefing on Cryptoassets produced during the application process for a 3-month internship with the Home Office’s Central Analysis and Insights Team.

Report







Master’s Dissertation




A Spatial Examination of Populism and Absenteeism in the UK in the Context of the 2016 EU Referendum — submitted 2018 for my MSc in Applied GIS at the University of Sheffield, winner of the Ian Masser Prize for best master’s dissertation.

Dissertation

title: Projects
text:
Portfolio
A selection of maps I have produced. Click for full size maps.





Map of London


A dasymetric map of London’s buildings, coloured by the largest ethnic minority of each neighbourhood. Produced as part of my MSc in Applied GIS.





Hexmap of New York City’s Trees


A hexagon-binned density map of all of New York City’s street trees. Produced as part of my MSc in Applied GIS.





Building age in Bristol


A point map of Bristol’s Buildings, visualising their construction date. Produced as part of the Retrofitting Rentals project.





Political Violence in Afghanistan


An animated map showing cumulative instances of political violence during the Taliban’s takeover of Afghanistan in 2021. Produced using ACLED data, for a QGIS workshop delivered to undergraduate students.
